test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act 2005 (Mahatma Gandhi NREGA) aims at enhancing ________ security of households in rural areas of the country by providing at least one hundred days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
solution:
The correct answer is: **livelihood**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.

 
 
• **Balanced **means keeping or showing a balance; in good proportions. (संतुलन रखना या दिखाना; अच्छे अनुपात में)
 
• **Total **means comprising the whole number or amount. (पूरी संख्या या राशि शामिल)
 
• **Strict **means demanding that rules concerning behaviour are obeyed and observed. (यह मांग करना कि व्यवहार से संबंधित नियमों का पालन और पालन किया जाता है)
 
• **Livelihood **means a means of securing the necessities of life. (जीवन की आवश्यकताओं को सुरक्षित करने का एक साधन)
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the passage is: MGNREGA seeks to increase the living standards of rural households in the nation.
 
• ​So, as per the meaning of the given words "**livelihood**" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Complete passage:** *The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act 2005 (Mahatma Gandhi NREGA) aims at enhancing **livelihood __**security of households in rural areas of the country by providing at least one hundred days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.*
